The LAST reference image is the original wall mural that this image replaces. Redraw it as closely as possible: the same composition and framing on the canvas (the ambulance at the same size and position, with the same empty margins around it), the same boxy ambulance and angle (blue beacons, pale blue windows, red and pink stripes, the red cross panel, dark wheels, the pale grey dust cloud behind it), the same giant syringe held forward to the left, the same thick dark-brown outlines, flat colours and worn scratched texture, the same amount of detail. The ONLY change: the rider sitting astride the ambulance roof is Wasami, drawn as one whole character in this doodle style: the same pose (sitting on the roof, legs hanging over the side with roller skates, both hands on the syringe), the same white nurse uniform with red trim, red gloves and red roller skates.
